notes: This bounded standard-API contract queries a registered attribute's original owner, unconditionally divests it and queries the unowned state, then verifies a second published federate's acquisition notification and a third query naming that federate. The native configured-process HLA_EVOKED case passed its focused CTest with host loopback access. The installed-package portable C++ primary/contract pair passed 4/4 direct runs (out/mgw/ownership-reacquisition-query-candidate-20261021.json) and 4/4 focused CTests across evoked/immediate callbacks (out/mgw/cpp-tck-unregulated-timestamped-attribute-20261021). Java source compiles against the official 2025 API JAR but has no provider runtime. Transport-specific behavior, competing-acquirer arbitration, independent-provider interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
